entry: Production repo_exec through the connected Poketto MCP client
checks: Pillow loads a Noto CJK font and draws Chinese text
640x480 RGB image resizes to 320x240 WebP and reopens at that size
BeautifulSoup with lxml extracts Chinese HTML text; lxml parses XML
DOCX paragraph and XLSX cell preserve Chinese text after save and reload
pypdf reads and copies a generated one-page PDF
pdfinfo and pdftotext execute without stderr
pdftoppm renders the PDF to a 200-pixel PNG without stderr
zip creates an archive; independent Python zipfile inspection confirms its entry
sideEffects: Only generated files under a temporary /tmp directory; removed on exit. No content save or publication.
deployment: 38 new distribution packages including dependencies, zero existing package upgrades, 125 MB reported additional disk usage; no application or worker restart
limits: Generated PDF contains an image, so this does not verify OCR, arbitrary PDF fonts, Office rendering or every supported image codec.
